title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-129-25二模

items.zh: 这部电影为推动中国文化走向世界做出了很大贡献。
items.en: This movie has contributed greatly to promoting Chinese culture to the world.

items.zh: 他忘了在饭盒上贴标签,有人不小心错拿了。
items.en: He forgot to label his lunchbox, so someone took it by mistake.

items.zh: 在中国,绿色能源发展迅速,越来越多的人选择电动汽车来保护环境和减少污染。
items.en: With green energy evolving rapidly in China, a growing number of people opt for electric vehicles to protect the environment and reduce pollution.

items.zh: 上周末,在春意盎然的植物园,我和我的初中英语王老师不期而遇,我们都非常激动。
items.en: Last weekend, I bumped into my junior high school English teacher in the botanical garden in full spring bloom, which made us both excited.
